notes.title: Achievements
notes.notes: Get steam achievements when you level up and beat the devil boss.

notes.title: Sound volume control
notes.notes: Can mute or change sound volume control in game options menu.

notes.title: Config resolution and auto save
notes.notes: Can config resolution before game start and the game will automatically save when passing the wave.

notes.title: Change FPS and fix some bugs
notes.notes: For optimize system resources. This update will change FPS to 60 frames per second and fix some bugs.
